intro_1: A new one! A new one! A new one!
intro_2: Quick traveller! The god of this forest wants to speak to you!
intro_3: Find him on his island in the lakes of this forest!

free_1: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you dear Traveller!
free_2: I am an Allay. I was send by the God of the Forest to seek the help of adventurers!
free_3: But these roudy thugs captured me before I could find anyone.
free_4: If you want to help us, throw this shard into a twilight pool to open the portal to our realm. I'll mark the location on this map.

hide_and_seek_start: Hihihi, let us play a game! Catch me three times, if you can!
hide_and_seek_found: Oh dear, caught again. But not for long!
hide_and_seek_won: You are a sharp-eyed one! Here, take this. Farewell, adventurer!
default: I am a brownie, what are you?
Do you want a cup of tea?
Do not trust the birds, dear adventurer. They will lead you astray.
Do you have seen my pet toad? I lost it somewhere around here. It is a very special toad, it can talk and it is very wise.
I have a secret to tell, but I cannot tell it to you. You are not a brownie, and only brownies can know the secrets of the brownie.
I have my favorite button, right here. It is a very special button, it is the only button that can make me laugh.
Sometimes the trees are talking to me. They are very silly fellows.
Have you seen these gigantic trees around here? I once knew a brownie that hid his secret stash in their branches. I wonder if it is still there.
You can make a brownie laugh by tickling it. But be careful, if you tickle it too much, it will get angry and it will chase you away.
Have you tried to tickle the trees? They are very ticklish, but they do not like it when you tickle them too much.
If you treat your leather and hang it to dry, you can make very special armor with it. I once saw a traveller jump three blocks high with his winged boots!
twilightforest:forest: Welcome to the forest adventurer. Night reigns here, respect it and you will be safe.
There once was a kingdom in these lands. A mighty king and a powerful queen ruled over it in prosperity.
There is no kingdom anymore. Anyone has been driven mad and the kings castle has been sealed away behind the thorns.
The Naga has her courtyard in these woods. She was once an adviser to the king, but fell victim to the wizard's curse.
Be careful around the Naga, she is powerful and will not hesitate to crush you.
twilightforest:mangrove_swamp: Climb up into my home, dear traveller. The swamp is not a safe place, is it not?
The wizard has his tower in these swamps. His foul magic seeps into it's waters and makes the dead rise with hunger.
Before the kingdom fell into chaos, the wizard was part of the king's court, but now he is a madman, corrupted by his own magic.
twilightforest:dense_forest: Welcome traveller. These are dark times for a visit to the forest of the night.
If you search for the kingdom, oh dear traveller, you have come too late.
After the queen's death, the kingdom fell into chaos.
The wizards hides away in his tower. He is corruped by curse and madness. He does not care for the living anymore.
The dead haunt the wizards castle. Be careful if you venture there.
twilightforest:firefly_forest: Welcome dear traveller. Sit down and rest a bit. Let yourself be enchanted by the firefly's dance.
There is an island in the lakes of these woods. An ancient god of the forest resides there.
The spirits of the forest were the first to be affected by the curse. Maybe some of them were protected by their god.
Be careful in the waters of the lakes. Their depths hide many dangers.
twilightforest:mushroom_forest: Welcome to the forest adventurer. Night reigns here, respect it and you will be safe.
The shroomlings are a curious bunch. The prattle away with no care in the world.
It is remarkable how the shroomlings seem to be immune to the madness that befell the king.
twilightforest:dense_mushroom_forest: Welcome adventurer. A beautiful night for a visit to the forest, is it not?
The shroomlings might seem innocent, but once they tried to overthrow the king!
The shroomlings once had a bond the minotaurs. But since the rebellion, the minotaurs have been driven away from here. You can still find their ruins in these parts of the woods.
twilightforest:oak_savannah: Dear traveller, what brings you to these parts?
The mad dwarves are a menace to the forest. They mine away for anything shiny.
The king's madness took hold of the dwarves' minds. They cannot be reasoned with anymore.
Please adventurer, would you free the forest of the mad dwarves' rampage?
twilightforest:darkwood: Psst adventurer, come closer. I have a secret to tell you.
The darkwood is a dangerous place. The trees are alive and they do not like visitors.
This is an ancient place. It was not affected by the kingdoms curse, it's darkness is way older than that.
These woods hide a secret of the wizard. He has a crimson tower in it's midst. Strange experiments happened there.
There is an old mansion in this forest. You should not go there, the mother of spiders has made it her dwelling.
After the queen's death, the king brought his royal guard to the old fortress. His axe struck them down one by one. Their spirits still linger in it's depths.
twilightforest:snowy_forest: Come to the fire, dear traveller. You must be freezing.
The snowy forest is a harsh place. Many travelers have perished in its icy grip.
The king's daughter, Princess Aurora lives in her castle ontop of the glacier.
Princess Aurora is a kind soul, but she fell victim to her own madness. Without her mother's guidance, she has become cold and cruel.
Her magic is unstable. Her coldness is seeping into this forest. She is the source of the blizzards that plague these woods.
twilightforest:amethyst_straits: A traveller? In these parts? You are brave, or foolish.
This is the heart of the kingdom. The pale monarch sits upon his throne in the castle of the night.
The dead haunt the castle. Be careful, the king's madness has made them restless.
The king had once bonded with a wolf of the forest. He named it Fenrir.
Fenrir has been changed by the wizards magic and it destroys everything in its path.
twilightforest:spooky_forest: What brings you to these parts of the woods? Only the dead walk upon these paths.
This place was once the beautiful garden of the queen and her death has left this place in mourning
Her guards still defend her castle and the catacombs beneath. Many treasures are hidden there, but many dangers as well.
She was buried somewhere in the catacombs. But no one knows where.
twilightforest:swamp: Oh dear, you look bitten to shreds by these blood sucking mosquitoes. You should be careful out there.
Most folks would say, these swamps are filthy. But I don't know what they are talking about. I think they are beautiful.
Be careful around the well. The kingdoms most dangerous criminals were once thrown into the labyrinth at its bottom.
The Hydra, the kings most dangerous weapon, lives in the center of the swamp. It's fire is hot, not even the strongest armor can withstand it.
Only the mightiest of the minotaurs ever survived a battle with the Hydra. But he is gone now, locked away in the labyrinth.
twilightforest:fire_swamp: What are doing here traveller? How are you managing in this heat?
The hydra has its lair not far from here, be careful when you venture deeper into the swamps.
The hydra' blood is a powerful reagent. It can imbue metal with the hydra's fiery might.
After the kingdom fell, the wizard visited the hydra on Aurora's orders. I don't know what he did, but no one has visited since.
twilightforest:highlands: The acid rain has stopped, has it not? Finally, I can venture out and see the world again.
The highlands are the home of the trolls. They have their caves deep underground.
Above us, the giant's island floats ontop of a cloud. I don't know how they manage to keep it afloat, but it is a sight to behold.

The trolls never liked the king. But they were loyal to the queen and her daughter. After the kingdom fell, Aurora visited the trolls, a lamp in her hands. Whatever she did, the trolls have been even fiercer since.
twilightforest:clearing: Welcome traveller. The night is beautiful, is it not? The stars are shining bright and the moon is full.
The trees are restless, traveller. Something is happening in the forest.
There once was a city, where the lake is now. It fell long ago, but it's ruins can still be found in the depths of the lake.

red: Why did the Creeper hang out with me? Because I'm such a fun-gi to be around!
They say I'm a fun-gi, but I think I'm just a cap-tivating conversationalist!
Looking for a spore-tacular time? You've found the right mushroom!
Did you hear about the fungi who threw a party? It was a real spore-gy!
My cousin Brownie is an alchemist.
Do you know of a bard named Smash Mouth? I hear he's an All Star.
I'm not a regular mushroom; I'm a spore-tacular mushroom!
Some people blame me for the apocalypse...
brown: Why do I feel like a fun-guy in a no-fun zone?
You want a piece of my spore attitude? Take a hike!
Life's a spore-t, and then you decompose.
Step back, or I'll give you a spore-tacular scowl!
Why do players always pick on mushrooms? Can't we just have a cap-py existence?
I'd rather be left alone in my dark corner. No mushroom for company!
I don't have mushroom for joy, just a whole lot of fung-titude!
I am responsible for the apocalypse.
I'm not grumpy, I'm just a fungi with a perpetual frown.
Why are you bothering me? Can't you see I'm having a spore day?
Why do players keep trying to cheer me up? Do I look like a sunflower to you?
I'm like a mushroom, growing in the darkness of my grumpy thoughts.
Step lightly, or you might awaken the wrath of the grumpy mushroom!
Why be a fun-guy when you can be a grump-guy?
I've mastered the art of being perpetually annoyed. It's my spore-cialty!
Let's get blazed! Go bring the blaze rod.
